Multiple Drug Seizures and Arrests Across India Reported

Several Indian news outlets reported on multiple drug seizures and arrests in various locations across the country. Incidents included the recovery of heroin and brown sugar, with arrests of individuals identified as drug smugglers and inter-state traffickers. Seized items ranged from small quantities to larger amounts of narcotics, along with cash, vehicles, and mobile phones.
